Row.Text: Complete this Project after the completion of the first three Space Race Projects to launch the first person into space and win a Scientific Victory.

When completed:[n]Adds a Nuclear Weapon to your arsenal, allowing you to use the WMD Strike action with a Bomber based in an [icon:UNIT_AERODROME_COMMANDER]Aerodrome, [icon:UNIT_SQUADRON_COMMANDER] Squadron or [icon:UNIT_CARRIER_COMMANDER] Aircraft Carrier Commander.
Increase the blast radius of WMD Strikes by 1.
+1 [icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food on Farms, Pastures, Plantations, and Fishing Boats. Can Purchase additional [icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food and Water Buildings in this Town.
+1 [icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food on Farms, Pastures, Plantations, and Fishing Boats. Can Purchase additional [icon:YIELD_FOOD] Food and Water Buildings in this Town.
+2 [icon:YIELD_PRODUCTION] Production on Camps, Woodcutters, Clay Pits, Mines, Oil Rig and Quarries.

+1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness and [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold on Appealing tiles. +50% tile yields from Natural Wonders. Can Purchase additional [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness Buildings in this Town.

+100% [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold towards purchasing a Factory, Port, or Rail Station in this town. +1 Resource Slot. +5 Trade Range. Can Purchase additional [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold Buildings in this Town. Must have an improved Factory Resource in this settlement.
+1 [icon:YIELD_DIPLOMACY] Influence per Settlement Connected to this Town. Can Purchase additional [icon:YIELD_DIPLOMACY] Diplomacy Buildings in this Town. Limited to 1 Hub Town per Continent.
+1 [icon:YIELD_HAPPINESS] Happiness to each Resource tile in the Town and +5 Trade Route range. Can Purchase additional [icon:YIELD_GOLD] Gold Buildings in this Town.
Grants 5 [icon:SCIENCE_VP] Innovation upon completion. Requires a Radio Station in the City. Each Civilization can only complete this Project once.
Grants 15 [icon:SCIENCE_VP] Innovation upon completion. Requires a Launch Pad in the City. Repeatable.

When completed:[BLIST][LI] Gain a [icon:UNIT_SQUADRON_COMMANDER] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_COMMANDER_TOOLTIP]Squadron Commander[/TIP].[LI] +5 [icon:SCIENCE_VP] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_INNOVATION_TOOLTIP]Innovation[/TIP].[/BLIST][n]Each Civilization can only complete this [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PROJECTS_TOOLTIP]Project[/TIP] once.

When completed:[BLIST][LI] +1 [icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT]Combat Strength to Air Units.[LI] +5 [icon:SCIENCE_VP] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_INNOVATION_TOOLTIP]Innovation[/TIP].[/BLIST][n]Each Civilization can only complete this [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PROJECTS_TOOLTIP]Project[/TIP] once.

When completed:[BLIST][LI] Reveals the entire map.[LI] +5 [icon:SCIENCE_VP] [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_INNOVATION_TOOLTIP]Innovation[/TIP].[/BLIST][n]Each Civilization can only complete this [TIP:LOC_PEDIA_CONCEPTS_PROJECTS_TOOLTIP]Project[/TIP] once.
